$comment: How BC Ferries' routes are drawn where the GTFS alone doesn't say; every route in the feed is drawn by default (route_type 4: ferries along their shapes, in their own colour), and the format is in config/feeds/translink/routes.json. The GTFS gives every route 000000 (export of 2026-10-09), which counts as no colour, so noColor gives them one sea blue of our own (not BC Ferries' branding, which we don't use). The major routes run the big vessels.

routes.label: Tsawwassen – Swartz Bay
routes.$kinematics: Spirit and Coastal class: 160-167 m, 28-32 m wide, about 21 knots (BC Ferries fleet pages, checked 2026-10-28).

routes.label: Horseshoe Bay – Departure Bay
routes.$kinematics: Coastal class and C class (139-160 m), about 20 knots (BC Ferries fleet pages, checked 2026-10-28).

routes.label: Tsawwassen – Duke Point
routes.$kinematics: Coastal class, about 21 knots (BC Ferries fleet pages, checked 2026-10-28).
